consequence.statement: With Helm 3.17.1, the null security context value in redis-ha subchart values.yaml would be rejected during chart validation, preventing successful chart deployment or upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to Argo CD 3.0.0 or later which removes the problematic null value, allowing Helm 3.17.1 to successfully validate and deploy the chart.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 removes a null security context value from the redis-ha Helm subchart values to resolve validation errors with Helm 3.17.1.

decision.reason: [ev-c5612ed57e07] is a single changelog line saying a null security context was removed from redis-ha values.yaml "to placate helm 3.17.1"; it states no failure, ignored setting, migration or access loss for an environment that upgrades and does nothing. The proposed kind setting-ignored also contradicts its own statement (it describes chart rejection, i.e. the pre-fix bug), and its remediation is merely "upgrade", so it over-claims mandatory work. The evidence does not support any specific consequence (not even a confirmed "none"); PR #22035 details would be needed to determine one.
